description:
The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) intends to award a single source contract to Will-Burt Company, 401 Collins Boulevard Orrville, OH for the repair, acquisition, and engineering services for the Will-Burt Mast System Assembly mounted on the Mobile Video Surveillance System (MVSS).

In accordance with the FAA Acquisition Management System Paragraph 3.2.2.4, the purpose of this announcement is to inform industry of the basis of the FAA's decision to contract with a selected source via single source procedures. Will-Burt Company is the only known source that can provide the repair and services to Will-Burt Mast assembly and associated components. Will-Burt Company is the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of this equipment. Will-Burt is the sole proprietary source for the technical data and drawings necessary to repair and/or replace the Mast Assembly.

The proposed principle North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this effort is 811210 Electronic and Precision Equipment Repair and Maintenance, with a size standard of $34 million. This announcement is for informational purposes only, not a Solicitation/Request for Proposal. Competitive solicitation is not available for this procurement. All questions pertaining to this announcement should be addressed in writing to the contracting Officer, Tamara Maxwell at tamara.m.maxwell@faa.gov. No phone calls will be accepted.
